description: Expected tool choice in ROUTER_MODE=tools. expect = tool names the model should call on its first round ([] = answer directly). args = partial match on the first call's arguments (case-insensitive strings). expectNoWeb = expected choice when web_search is not offered (--no-web-search). noClaim = regex a no-tool answer must not match (an unchecked live fact). Billing and hold phrases never reach the model in tools mode, so they are not listed.
